description: This Dart source file defines classes related to managing and providing recommendation data in a Flutter application. It includes data models, a service class with mock and future real API integration, and a ChangeNotifier provider for UI state management.

classes.name: RecommendationItem
classes.description: A data model representing a recommendation card to be displayed on the home screen, including properties like id, title, subtitle, call-to-action label, target route, route arguments, and an optional tag.

classes.name: RecommendationsService
classes.description: A service class responsible for fetching AI recommendations, either from mock data or from a real API in future implementations. It holds configuration parameters like useMocks and baseUrl.

classes.name: RecommendationsProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages the state of recommendations used in the UI, including initialization, refresh, loading state, and error handling. It interacts with RecommendationsService to fetch data.

methods.name: RecommendationItem.constructor
methods.description: Constructs a RecommendationItem with required fields such as id, title, subtitle, ctaLabel, targetRoute, and optional routeArgs and tag.

methods.name: RecommendationsService.create
methods.description: Creates and returns a Future instance of RecommendationsService, initializing it with environment configuration values.

methods.name: RecommendationsService.fetchRecommendations
methods.description: Fetches a list of RecommendationItem objects; currently returns mock data or throws an unimplemented error for real API.

methods.name: RecommendationsProvider.init
methods.description: Initializes the provider by fetching recommendations, sets loading/error states, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: RecommendationsProvider.refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the recommendations by resetting initialization state and re-fetching data.
